$comment: Exemptions for the slop lint (src/lib/slop.ts, npm run lint:slop). acronyms: capital words allowed in prose (acronyms and format tokens such as YYYY). properNouns: words and phrases that keep their capitals in sentence-case headings. radius: {component, class?, reason} where a radius over 4px means something. money: {file?, texts, reason}, exact currency strings allowed in src/content (ADR 0003 item 3). Keep each list short; every radius and money entry needs a reason.

money.reason: Assets of the two client firms, a size that describes the clients without naming them; not revenue, savings or a deal value (ADR 0003 item 3). Listed for the owner to confirm.
Public list prices per million tokens from the vendors' own pages (dated in the post) and the synthetic worked examples built on them; no employer figures.
